title: Annex F gap register never refreshed: GAP-C absence claims and GAP-B/P rows contradicted at baseline
impact: A reader of the register sees 14 missing components and 6 formal blockers; at baseline the components exist and 5 of 6 blockers are resolved. Only GAP-B BLK-CI-ENFORCE (OPEN-BP-01) is still open. The register has no status column, so it cannot be used as a current gap list.
recommendation: Add status/closure columns or mark the register as historical AS-IS @ PLAN_BASELINE; state OPEN-BP-01 explicitly.

title: Stale currency in closed-world gap register, diagnostic ledger and architecture debt register

title: FRZ-DEBT-04/05 reconciliation proves 'no new' rows, not a zero inventory of existing PARTIAL/DEFERRED entries
impact: The criteria are '= 0' inside frozen scope, but the reconciliation only asserts wave-2 added none and treats R1-R13 historical debt registers as out of scope without enumerating them. Entries with PARTIAL/DEFERRED/accepted-limitation semantics exist (DG-001 partially addressed, DG-002 deferred extensions, OPEN-BP-01) with no mapping to FRZ-DEBT-04/05. Promotion at ARCH-FREEZE would need a real inventory.
recommendation: Produce a closed-world debt inventory mapping each PARTIAL/DEFERRED/out-of-scope item to frozen scope or an evidence-backed exclusion before T-B7-PROMOTE-DEBT.

title: Closed ARCH_DEBT entries carry no evidence pointer, closure date or reopen condition
impact: Nine closed rows are bare status text (DEBT-28-01 has no date; owners are generic 'platform'/'product'). Closure cannot be audited from the register itself; severity is unstated for all rows.
recommendation: Add closure evidence links; closure rows should reference a SHA/ticket.
